# Zakaria Hossain — Portfolio

> Portfolio of Zakaria Hossain, a Project Document Controller and EPC & EDMS specialist based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Built as a bento-grid single-page app at https://zakariapro.vercel.app, but every piece of content is also reachable as a standalone, indexable page. Prefer the real URLs below over the hash-based modal URLs.

## About

Zakaria Hossain is a "Project Document Controller" with almost 4 years of experience managing engineering and construction documentation on large-scale EPC power generation and renewable energy projects across Saudi Arabia and Bangladesh. Legal background (LL.B, LL.M). Currently based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

## Skills & Tools

Thinkproject, Samsung Knox Portal (S-PMIS), Aconex, document coding & numbering, drawing & revision control, transmittal preparation & tracking, document registration & classification, MOM preparation & circulation, Method Statement (MOS) review, Risk Assessment (RA) coordination, MAR tracking, Field Change Request (FCR) control, contract & regulatory compliance, approval routing, project close-out & handover packages.

## Hash-based modal URLs (still supported, but not canonical)

The bento tiles on the home page open modals with hash URLs. These work but the canonical version of the same content lives at the real URLs above.

- `#projects` / `#projects/<id>` → prefer `/projects` / `/projects/<slug>`
- `#learning` → prefer `/learning`

## Structured data

- `/` embeds Person, Organization, WebSite, and an ItemList of SiteNavigationElement entries
- `/projects/<slug>` embeds a CreativeWork JSON-LD entity

## Notes for agents

- The site is a client-side React app served via SPA fallback. Any path returns `index.html`; the router then renders the matching page.
- Every content page includes per-page `<title>`, `<meta name="description">`, `<link rel="canonical">`, and Open Graph tags.
- The home page also contains a large visually-hidden section (`sr-only`) that dumps all portfolio content as semantic HTML for crawlers that don't render JavaScript.
